body:
New task file: research/TASK_K20.md. Model top tier, effort high, Fast off. Study only - no .gd, no .tscn. Push only your own research files and do not edit HANDOFF.md; I write your block.

FightContractScreen.gd is the LAST pre-kit screen in the game - 702 lines still defining its own palette while every other rail hub was rebuilt on UIKit. R33 replaces it, and while it is open we are closing the gap the C18 survey found: our booking prices the TERMS but never grades the PROPOSITION. Pound for Pound grades every bout it offers and prints the reasons as chips; we show money and clauses and never say whether the fight is a good idea.

You rule how that reads. Five questions in the task file: is the graded board a state of SCHEDULE or its own thing; what the verdict vocabulary is in FightCamp's voice (C19's five placeholder values are the API side talking, and K19 already ruled letter-grade soup out); where the gate projection lives, since it is the number the gate-point clause takes a slice of and it is currently invisible; whether the agreement keeps its paper BOUT AGREEMENT metaphor or that is the legacy talking; and how a promoter counter and a walk-away read without becoming a wall of text.

Suggested boards: THE BOARD, THE AGREEMENT, STATES, THE SEAM. Deliverables BOOKING_K20.html + PNGs + K20_DIGEST.md in the K19 shape.

Kit rulings bind: gold exactly once per board, green is the way out only, SIZE_MIN 12, silhouettes never portraits, the facility is a GYM. Females never fight males and booking matches weight classes - these are RULES, so they never appear as a reason chip. Invent no numbers.
topic: K20 assigned: the booking, how it reads
